unverifiable_exemptions: Vacation or recreational lease, rental, occupancy or tenancy of 100 days or less (subsection 9)
coverage.summary: Applies statewide to residential tenancies of any building size or owner type. Vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less are excluded.
coverage.other_conditions: Does not apply to vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less (subsection 9).

result.notes: The rule covers ordinary residential tenancies, so requires_unknown_facts is false. The vacation-rental exclusion (subsection 9) cannot be checked from assessor data, so it is listed in unverifiable_exemptions as well as other_conditions. I removed the reference to lessors' agents (effective August 1, 2025) from the summary because it describes who is bound by the conduct rule, not which buildings, units or owners are covered. The statute has no unit-count, construction-date, owner-occupancy or landlord-size limits.
